issue.description:
Perform comprehensive git log analysis between attempt-resolution-pre and attempt-resolution-complete tags to verify the feature implementation timeline.

Acceptance criteria:
- Git log between tags shows the correct sequence of attempt-resolution commits
- All commits between boundaries are related to attempt-resolution feature
- Commits match the documented timeline in docs/boundaries/attempt-resolution-feature.md
- No unrelated commits appear between the boundary points
- Feature implementation follows the expected pattern (specs → checkpoint → service)

issue.description:
The environment docs prescribe `bead create --issue-type genesis` (a custom type) as the standard root bead for multi-phase projects, but the supplied bead-rs documentation never documents custom issue types and no bead covers them. Verify the CLI and store accept a non-enum issue type and that it round-trips through checkpoint publish/restore, list/show projections, and the field guide, adding tests for each; if issue types are a closed enumeration, implement documented custom-type support or report the conflict so the environment workflow doc can be corrected instead of prescribing a command that fails.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Support or formally restrict the custom issue types the genesis workflow depends on
